chunks: Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from Abi Jamilah, from Jabir, from Abi Ja'far عليه السلام, who said:
The Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله said: “There is nothing among your clothing better than white, so wear it and shroud your dead in it.”
ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله say about wearing white clothes and shrouding the dead in them?
ai.summary: This hadith states the excellence of white clothing and recommends wearing it. It also recommends using white cloth for shrouding the deceased, connecting personal attire with funerary practice.
